checks.name: function_identity
checks.rationale: Binary Ninja identifies App_ContextSetDebugtextState at 0x0048F1E0; the address-qualified GameNatives body and candidate target the same entry.

checks.name: argument_mapping
checks.rationale: The retail MOVSX EAX, byte ptr [ESP+4] sign-extends the first cdecl byte argument; the candidate accepts std::int8_t and promotes it to std::int32_t.

checks.name: constants_and_scaling
checks.rationale: No constants or scaling; the promoted input is stored and returned unchanged.

checks.name: memory_layout_and_access
checks.rationale: Retail writes EAX to 0x005C8BF4. The port maps this global to AppContextState::debug_text_state and stores the same 32-bit value.

checks.name: calls_and_side_effects
checks.rationale: The retail body has no calls and one global write; candidate has no calls and one corresponding state-field write.

checks.name: return_and_error_paths
checks.rationale: RET leaves the MOVSX result in EAX; there are no branches or error paths.

limits: Static semantic review; no live IGI.exe process comparison.
Candidate maps the retail absolute global to port-owned AppContextState.
